trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Dharwad, MC No.58/2020
case_name: Smt.Jayashree W/O Gulappa Pujar vs Sri Gulappa S/O Basappa Pujar

parties.respondent_defendant: Sri Gulappa S/O Basappa Pujar (husband) and Rachayya S/O Channabasayya Halligerimath

facts_of_case: The wife filed a petition under Section 13(1)(i)&(ia)&(ib) of Hindu Marriage Act against the husband seeking dissolution of marriage. The husband alleged that the wife had extra marital life with respondent no.2 and sought decree of divorce. The trial court rejected the application filed by the husband for rejection of the plaint.
